story_bible.logline: Shehar se aayi Riya dadi ke ghar ka purana aaina bechne nikalti hai, par raat ko aaine mein dikhi aurat usse darane nahi, bachane aayi hai.
story_bible.synopsis: Riya store room se ek purana aaina nikaalti hai taaki use bech sake. Raat ko aaine mein ek aurat dikhti hai. Dari hui Riya uske ishaare ke peeche kitchen jaati hai aur dekhti hai ki gas khuli reh gayi thi. Subah dadi batati hai ki woh aurat unki behen Kamla thi, jo hamesha parivaar ki raksha karti thi.
story_bible.theme: Har dikhne waala darr dushman nahi hota.
